name: Create ID Card Request
description: Creates a new ID card request. Requires multipart/form-data with three files (passportPhoto, utilityBill, ref_letter). Files are validated (MIME/extension, max 1MB, passport photo quality) and uploaded to Cloudinary. A unique BIN (e.g. '1234 567 8901') and a 4-year expiration date are auto-generated. Throws if the user already has a Pending request or an Approved request with pending payment.
validation: Business rule: User must not have an existing Pending ID card request
Business rule: User must not have an Approved request with pending payment

name: Update ID Card Request
description: Updates an existing ID card request owned by the authenticated user. Supports multipart/form-data for optional file replacement (passportPhoto, utilityBill, ref_letter). Only allowed when the request status is Pending or Rejected.
validation: Business rule: Request must belong to the authenticated user
Business rule: Status must be 'Pending' or 'Rejected'
Business rule: Cannot edit an approved or processed request

errorResponses.message: ID Card request not found.
